articles.title: Angela Murphy, 91, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Murphy for the many years of service to Upper Commons.
body: Born in Upper Commons in the years after the war, Angela Murphy spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foxglove Heights Neighbors in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Upper Commons.
Angela Murphy died in January at home on Canton Terrace, at the age of 91.

articles.title: Zoning Board Hears Plan for Stormwater Drain Repair Near Stonebridge
articles.deck: The vote came after 16 residents spoke at Saturday’s session.
body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

Residents of Stonebridge said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Public works estimates the work will take about 16 weeks once it starts in December. Councilmember Ellis Feeney asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $850.
